newsitem.title: BELGIUM: NATO confirms deal with Russia.
newsitem.headline: NATO confirms deal with Russia.

text.p: NATO confirmed officially on Wednesday it had reached a deal with Russia on a new relationship after talks in Moscow between Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov and NATO Secretary General Javier Solana.

"The agreed text will be submitted for consideration to the NATO governments through the North Atlantic Council, and to (Russian) President (Boris) Yeltsin," NATO said in a joint statement with Russia released in Brussels.
Referring to the negotiations in Moscow, the statement said: "Decisive progress was reached on key issues of the NATO/Russia document, including its military aspects"
The two sides have been seeking an agreement that will forge a new relationship between the old Cold War foes ahead of NATO's enlargement into eastern Europe.
